name: Identify an immediate hazard
short_description: Scan an ordinary setting and identify one hazard that could cause injury within minutes.
self_assessment: I can identify one immediate injury hazard in an unfamiliar room without help.
description: Scan an ordinary setting and identify one hazard that could cause injury within minutes. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Notice a blocked exit or unstable object

builds_on.note: Written safety notices support systematic hazard checks.
